story.title: Ravi's Story: Proactive Groundwater Planning
story.subtitle: How a smallholder farmer in Telangana prevented crop failure using Bhoomijal's 6-month early forecast.
story.step1Desc: In Medak, Ravi cultivated paddy depending on an aging 200ft borewell. In previous years, without warning, the well would sputter and dry up mid-season during April, resulting in severe debt.
story.step2Desc: In November, Ravi clicked his village on Bhoomijal. The model projected the aquifer depth dropping from 12.5m to 19.8m (Critical stress) by March due to receding post-monsoon tables.
story.step3Desc: With 4 months of advance warning, Ravi switched 60% of his acreage from water-intensive paddy to pearl millet and pigeon pea. He also constructed a trench recharge pit around his borewell.
story.step4Desc: When peak summer struck in April, surrounding wells failed, but Ravi's water demand was 50% lower, and his recharge pit buffered the aquifer. His family secured a profitable harvest.
